<b>Ballow</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. He is a [[Dock Workers|Dock Worker]] who is [[Forge Daughter]]'s assistant, and is involved in the <i>[[SEEK: The Dark Below]]</i> [[Objectives|objective]].<ref name=fg>[[Forge Daughter]]: <i>"We hope Ballow serves you well, pointy bug. In our long time serving these docks, he's the finest assistant we've found."</i></ref>

== Background ==
Ballow is a young [[Smelt Shoveller]] who is the assistant of Forge Daughter.<ref name=fg/><ref name=sense>[[Forge Daughter]]: <i>"It's only ourselves and young Ballow with any sense left."</i></ref> He can be found shovelling smelt into a metal carapace beside her shop. He and Forge Daughter are the only workers in the [[Deep Docks]] who still have their senses.<ref name=sense/> Ballow is mostly concerned with his work, and dislikes interruptions.<ref name=busy/><ref>Ballow: <i>"Can't you see I'm busy, miss? Ain't got time for naught else while the shovelling needs doing."</i></ref>

== In-Game Events ==
When Ballow is working next to Forge Daughter, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can needle-bounce on him, which deals no damage to him but makes Forge Daughter laugh if done enough times.

If the Bench in the sauna room in the lower area of the Deep Docks is unlocked and then Hornet rests elsewhere, upon revisiting it, Ballow can be found there enjoying the sauna. After speaking to him and resting elsewhere, he can be found working next to Forge Daughter again.

During the <i>SEEK: The Dark Below</i> objective in [[Act 3]], after speaking with Ballow, he agrees to fix the [[Diving Bell|diving bell]]. He moves to the diving bell's control panel, accessible through an opened floor gate in the upper right corner of the diving bell's room. After speaking to him there, he gives Hornet the [[Diving Bell Key]], allowing her to enter the diving bell and descend into [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]].

After Hornet's first escape from the Abyss, Ballow retrieves the diving bell and starts repairing it with additional reinforcements. Once Hornet obtains the [[Everbloom]], the bell is ready, allowing Hornet to safely descend into and return from the Abyss at any time.

== Location ==
Ballow is located in the same room as Forge Daughter in Deep Docks. He can be found in the Deep Docks sauna after it's opened; after the encounter, he moves back to his usual location next to Forge Daughter.

After talking to him during the <i>[[SEEK: The Dark Below]]</i> [[Objectives|objective]], he moves to the diving bell's control panel.

== Trivia ==
* Within the intact diving bell, Ballow can be heard singing through the speaker if the [[Needolin]] is played. However, his Needolin dialogue does not appear.
* When Needle-bouncing on Ballow, he makes the same sound when Needle-bouncing on a [[Flintstone Flyer]], even though he resembles a Smelt Shoveller.
